claim_candidates.subject: UMP information model
claim_candidates.observed_claim: NIST documents a reference schema for Unit Manufacturing Process information and links it to recording/storing process models and characterization.
claim_candidates.caveat: A schema/reference implementation does not populate FORGE with complete process data.
unknowns: Coverage of all process families, parameters, uncertainty and qualification evidence.

entity_resolution.method: source locator only; no equivalence inference

claim_candidates.escalation: Map only decision-sensitive process nodes and retain missing fields as UNKNOWN.

claim_candidates.subject: UNIDO Statistics Portal
claim_candidates.observed_claim: UNIDO exposes INDSTAT, IIP, manufacturing trade, CIP and related industrial comparison datasets.
claim_candidates.caveat: Statistics scope and definitions do not directly establish facility-level qualified capacity.
unknowns: Crosswalk from macro categories to product/process/facility capability and evidence dates.
claim_candidates.escalation: Use as context and trace each derived measure to its scope.

claim_candidates.subject: World Steel Association
claim_candidates.observed_claim: World Steel reports 2025 world crude steel production of 1,849 Mt, India 164.9 Mt and China 960.8 Mt within its stated scope.
claim_candidates.caveat: Production is not specialty-grade material, qualified component supply, utilization or available capacity.
unknowns: Grade mix, downstream conversion, yield, allocation and available supply.
conflicts: Conflicts ledger c1: production/nameplate versus qualified available capacity.
claim_candidates.escalation: Attach material-grade and downstream capability evidence before using in product feasibility.

claim_candidates.subject: India ASI 2023-24
claim_candidates.observed_claim: ASI reports 260,061 factories, 195,889,131 persons engaged, INR 15,327,831,609 lakh output and INR 2,458,333,605 lakh GVA within its estimated aggregate scope.
claim_candidates.caveat: Aggregate macro measures are not qualified skill, product throughput, localization or available capacity.
unknowns: Product/process/facility mappings, formal/informal coverage, utilization and qualification.
conflicts: Conflicts ledger c2: manufacturing growth versus uneven capital-goods investment/utilization.
claim_candidates.escalation: Crosswalk only where decision-sensitive and preserve aggregate scope.

claim_candidates.subject: India Semiconductor Mission
claim_candidates.observed_claim: ISM remit covers semiconductor/display ecosystem schemes and a global electronics manufacturing/design hub, but the page does not establish fab yield, throughput or domestic value-add.
claim_candidates.caveat: Policy remit is not operating qualified capacity.
unknowns: Facility-specific yield, throughput, customer qualification and domestic content.
claim_candidates.escalation: Keep semiconductor facilities as announced/planned unless dated operating evidence exists.

claim_candidates.subject: FAO sustainable mechanization
claim_candidates.observed_claim: FAO defines mechanization across hand tools through sophisticated motorized farming and processing technologies and exposes equipment/manufacturer dimensions.
claim_candidates.caveat: A taxonomy/equipment database does not prove installed, qualified or available supplier capacity.
unknowns: Installed base, field reliability, domestic content and qualified production rate.
conflicts: Conflicts ledger c8: precision-ag adoption narratives versus installed-base evidence.
claim_candidates.escalation: Use lazy recursion to investigate agriculture nodes only when decision-sensitive.

claim_candidates.subject: AHRI 550/590
claim_candidates.observed_claim: AHRI standards cover performance rating of factory-made water-chilling and water-heating packages using vapor-compression cycles within specified scope and exclusions.
claim_candidates.caveat: A standard defines rating/qualification scope; it does not show a company’s qualified capacity.
unknowns: Supplier-specific product qualification, yield and recurring available capacity.
claim_candidates.escalation: Attach product test records and capacity state to any HVAC candidate.

claim_candidates.subject: Tier-2/tier-3 supplier capacity
claim_candidates.observed_claim: The ledger leaves qualified available capacity of Indian tier-2/tier-3 suppliers UNKNOWN because approval, yield, utilization and allocation evidence is absent.
claim_candidates.caveat: Do not infer capacity from cluster presence or macro output.
claim_candidates.escalation: Resolve with audited supplier records, customer approvals and allocation evidence.

claim_candidates.subject: Kirloskar Brothers test facility
claim_candidates.observed_claim: The ledger records a reported 50,000 m3/h hydraulic test discharge envelope for a Kirloskar Brothers test facility.
claim_candidates.caveat: A test envelope is not annual pump production or available qualified supply.
unknowns: Product mix, test utilization, qualification and recurring output.
claim_candidates.escalation: Validate the cited facility page and attach product-level throughput evidence.

claim_candidates.subject: CNC localization
claim_candidates.observed_claim: The corpus identifies local value-add of Indian-made CNC machines and high-end controller readiness as unresolved dependencies.
claim_candidates.caveat: Final assembly and machine-tool presence do not prove autonomous controller/spindle/ball-screw capability.
unknowns: BOM origin, controller TRL, simultaneous 5-axis qualification, installed base and acceptance.
conflicts: Conflicts ledger c6: domestic assembly versus localization.
claim_candidates.escalation: Resolve only for a decision-sensitive CNC recursion branch.

claim_candidates.subject: PMSM versus induction/SynRM/SRM
claim_candidates.observed_claim: The conflict ledger records a tradeoff between permanent-magnet density/efficiency and rare-earth-free supply resilience/lifecycle risk.
claim_candidates.caveat: No universal architecture winner; duty cycle, magnet supply, inverter cost and qualification are decision variables.
unknowns: Application-specific performance, cost, qualification and supply risk.
claim_candidates.escalation: Model by duty cycle and dependency graph rather than globally merging architectures.

claim_candidates.subject: Metrology/qualification
claim_candidates.observed_claim: The ledger treats CMM, laser, gauges, NDT, functional testing and calibration as a metrology/qualification capability needed to accept machining output.
claim_candidates.caveat: Metrology capability is not itself proof of qualified product output; scope, calibration and customer acceptance remain explicit.
unknowns: Facility-level traceability, uncertainty budgets, calibration intervals and product approval.
claim_candidates.escalation: Recurse into metrology only when acceptance risk is decision-sensitive.

claim_candidates.subject: Nested research package
claim_candidates.observed_claim: The extracted corpus includes a nested research-package ZIP containing 20 files and 2 directory entries; it is retained as an opaque artifact and not expanded into top-level records.
claim_candidates.caveat: Internal members may duplicate top-level content; no duplicate promotion or graph completeness is inferred.
unknowns: Whether every embedded member is byte-identical to a top-level artifact without recursive expansion in this bounded pass.
claim_candidates.escalation: Expand only if a decision-sensitive source is missing from top-level artifacts.
